note: Workflow buttons replaces the Content Moderation moderation_state select + Save button with one submit button per allowed transition (labelled from the transition name). It provides the workflow_buttons field widget for the moderation_state field (set on Manage form display; widget setting show_current_state) and a global settings form workflow_buttons.settings with display.top_buttons. Requires workflows + content_moderation. No permissions, no Drush. IMPORTANT for graders: on this shared test site the moderation_state widget is a Content-Moderation-managed base-field default and is NOT stored in entity_form_display config (raw config is null), and no node bundle is currently moderated; combined with an unrelated broken workbench_moderation install, the widget placement is not reliably verifiable. So medium/hard cases are grounded in the module's reliably-writable global config workflow_buttons.settings:display.top_buttons (top+bottom vs bottom-only button placement), verified against live config. Recipe cases still cover the widget itself.

evals.prompt: How do I make a moderated content type show workflow action buttons instead of the moderation-state dropdown, using the workflow_buttons module?
evals.expected_output: On the bundle's Manage form display, set the Moderation state field's widget to 'Workflow buttons' (widget id workflow_buttons). The bundle must be under a content_moderation workflow; the module also registers it as the moderation_state default form widget.

evals.prompt: In workflow_buttons, how do I make the workflow buttons appear at the top of the edit form as well as the bottom, and where is that setting?
evals.expected_output: Enable 'Buttons on top and bottom' on the settings form at /admin/config/workflow/workflow-buttons; it sets workflow_buttons.settings:display.top_buttons to true.

evals.prompt: Where do the labels on the workflow_buttons buttons come from, and what does the widget's 'show current state' option do?
evals.expected_output: Each button is labelled from its workflow transition's label (one button per allowed transition). The widget's show_current_state setting adds the current moderation state to the form's meta/sidebar section.

evals.prompt: On this site, workflow_buttons is configured. Inspect the live workflow_buttons settings and state whether the workflow buttons are shown at both the top and bottom of the edit form.
evals.expected_output: workflow_buttons.settings:display.top_buttons is true, so the buttons appear at both the top and the bottom of the form.

evals.prompt: Inspect the live workflow_buttons configuration on this site: are the workflow buttons currently shown at the top of the edit form, or only at the bottom?
evals.expected_output: workflow_buttons.settings:display.top_buttons is false, so the buttons appear only at the bottom of the form (not at the top).

evals.prompt: Configure the workflow_buttons module on this site so that the workflow buttons appear at BOTH the top and the bottom of the content edit form. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: workflow_buttons.settings:display.top_buttons is set to true (the 'Buttons on top and bottom' option at /admin/config/workflow/workflow-buttons).

evals.prompt: The workflow buttons on this site currently appear at both the top and the bottom of the edit form. Reconfigure workflow_buttons so they appear only at the bottom. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: workflow_buttons.settings:display.top_buttons is set to false, so the buttons render only at the bottom of the form.
